prompt: Create a production game VFX sprite atlas in simplified Pocket Chibi pixel art: bold dark outlines, flat 3-tone colors, square pixels, no blur or bloom. Transparent PNG background (genuine alpha zero, no checkerboard, no haze). EXACT uniform grid: EIGHT columns by SIX rows, 48 square cells. Every cell has a centered isolated effect fully within its cell with 15% empty transparent margins. Each row contains TWO different four-frame animations, columns 1-4 animation A and columns 5-8 animation B. The four frames progress small anticipation, full burst, fragments, fading sparse fragments. ROW 1: A orange fire burst; B cyan icicle and snowflake burst. ROW 2: A green healing plus signs and sparkles; B acid green poison bubbles and tiny skull puff. ROW 3: A golden angular lightning bolt crackle; B violet arcane rune pulse. ROW 4: A silver curved sword slash and hit sparks; B brown stone shatter and dust blocks. ROW 5: A green leafy roots sprouting and curling; B burgundy red blood/vampire mist burst. ROW 6: A golden holy star rays; B blue protective shield pulse. Consistent cell spacing, readable simple shapes suitable for a cute fantasy tactics game. No characters, UI panels, text, labels, borders, grid lines or background.
